facts.text: Title 'Brannkonsept for reguleringsfase'; project number AA378; dated 16.11.2021; prepared by Eivind Ekerold; quality-assured by Mikhail Antonov. Client shown as Tolpinrud Torg (full name not captured by extraction).

Summary: risk classes 2, 4 and 5 for the building volumes; fire classes 2 and 3 for residential; fire class 3 for underground car park and commercial areas; sprinklers throughout; commercial areas and car park designed to NS-EN 12845.
Specified requirements may not be deviated from unless agreed in writing with RIBr.

The deviation analysis (fraviksanalyse) is deferred to the next phase. Candidate measures include overpressure ventilation of the fire lock in front of the car park, and/or pressurising the stairwell.
A separate fire cell is required between the lift shaft and the car park.
Fire site plan is referred to as 'situasjonsplan brann' in chapter 6 (p. 10) and as 'Se kap 5' (p. 11). The last PDF page is titled 'Situasjonsplan Brann'.
Classification follows the risk class and number of storeys (§ 11-2 / § 11-3).
